topics.title: Concepts, Scope, Resources, Attractions, Statistics, Benefits, and Cultural Heritages

subtopics.content: Definitions of tourism, tourist, visitor, tour, excursion, leisure, hospitality, travel; scope and history of tourism; domestic vs international tourism; inbound/outbound, long/short haul, eco, cultural, religious, and sports tourism; components (attraction, accessibility, amenities); tourist product characteristics; natural, man-made, and socio-cultural tourist attractions in Nigeria; tourism statistics (inflow, outflow, expenditure patterns); economic, social, and developmental benefits; major Nigerian cultural festivals (Argungu, Osun-Osogbo, New Yam) and UNESCO world heritage sites (Sukur site, museums, monuments, palaces)
subtopics.objective: Define tourism concepts and trace historical developments; categorize forms and types of tourism; explain the 3 As (Attraction, Accessibility, Amenities) and tourist product characteristics; locate key natural, man-made, and socio-cultural tourist attractions across Nigeria; collect and interpret tourism arrival/expenditure statistics; evaluate economic, social, and infrastructure benefits of tourism; describe major Nigerian cultural festivals, museums, shrines, and heritage sites.

topics.title: Travel Business, Operations, Public/Private Agencies, Marketing, and Entrepreneurship

subtopics.content: Travel motivators (physiological, economic, social); travel agency functions (reservations, ticketing, visa, forex); tour operator roles (packaging, marketing, execution); support services (banking, insurance, car hire, hotel, health, security); roles of public agencies (Federal Ministry of Tourism, NTDC/NTDA, NIHOTOUR, NCMM) and private bodies (FTAN, NANTA, NATOP, HATMAN); tourism marketing strategies (segmentation, niche marketing, media, e-tourism); cottage industries (leather, pottery, tie-dye, weaving); service delivery jobs; and skill acquisition institutions (SMEDAN, NDE, NIHOTOUR)
subtopics.objective: Analyze physiological, economic, and social reasons for travel; detail roles, functions, and qualities of travel agents and tour operators; identify essential support services in tourism; evaluate functions of public regulatory agencies (NTDC, NIHOTOUR, NCMM) and private trade associations (FTAN, NANTA, NATOP); apply marketing tools, e-tourism platforms, and segmentation strategies; explore cottage industry enterprise opportunities, customer service roles, and national skill acquisition centers.
